a0XSJ000004oTR72AM.title: Platte County Missouri Farm
a0XSJ000004oTR72AM.description: Former Fort Leavenworth disciplinary farm on the east side of the Missouri River. Several former prison-farm structures remain on the land. GSA describes the sale as coming soon.
a0XSJ000004oTR72AM.disclaimer: The property is part of the Missouri River Levee system and Farley-Beverly Drainage District. Public bidding has not opened; review the sale documents for the full conditions.

a0XSJ0000046KPx2AM.spec: Over 1 million gross sq ft · 5.49 acres
a0XSJ0000046KPx2AM.description: The Robert C. Weaver Building in Southwest Washington, DC, next to L’Enfant Plaza Metrorail Station. GSA says it will be offered through an online auction.
a0XSJ0000046KPx2AM.disclaimer: Auction announced as coming soon. No current bid is published; review GSA’s eventual sale documents for deposits, occupancy and reuse restrictions.

a0XSJ000004EuT32AK.description: Pearsall Federal Building and Post Office. The GSA record lists the disposal method as a reimbursable federal transfer and says coming soon.
a0XSJ000004EuT32AK.disclaimer: This is listed as a reimbursable transfer to a federal agency, not a public auction. Eligibility and transfer terms must be confirmed with GSA.

a0X3d000001PtKYEA0.title: 33 Fort Kamehameha Bungalows — Offsite Removal
a0X3d000001PtKYEA0.description: Thirty-three bungalow-style homes at Joint Base Pearl Harbor–Hickam, Oahu, are offered for removal from the site.
a0X3d000001PtKYEA0.disclaimer: Land is not included. The homes contain lead-based paint and asbestos-containing materials; specialized relocation and renovation expertise is required.
